D2N077.label: Short doctor's note
D2N077.description: Brief shorthand a doctor writes right after the visit.
D2N077.note_text:
R wrist injury yesterday AM. Slipped on stairs carrying laundry, landed on outstretched arms. Pain 9/10, swelling. No prior injury to R arm. Ice, ACE wrap and ibuprofen with some relief.
Exam: R wrist tender on palpation, pain on flexion/extension, swelling and bruising, bony crepitus. Metacarpals intact.
X-ray: Colles fracture, extra-articular, dorsal angulation, ulnar styloid fracture.
Plan: ORIF asap, overnight stay. Brace 6 weeks. Ultram 50 mg q6h for pain. PT 3x/week after surgery. Follow-up in 1 month.
